thesis_triggers.event: Kept at $335 on review 2026-11-04 (no cited evidence moves it): AMAT traded through it intraday on 2026-11-05 (325.40 low area, Twelve Data, src 57) on sector sentiment, not on any of the fundamental conditions it stands for, checked one by one: (1) customer capex cuts at the October prints - none; Intel 2027 capex 'up strongly' (src 51), SK hynix 2027 investment 'increase significantly' (src 52), TSMC 3Q26 capex $13.84B (src 55), KLA 2027 WFE >$200B (src 50); (2) an AMAT guide-down - not yet tested (FQ4 FY26 prints 2026-11-12, AMAT release 2026-10-22, src 63); (3) the Affiliates Rule returning - still open: BIS stayed it 'until November 9, 2026' (Federal Register 2025-19846, src 62) and no Federal Register notice extends the stay as of 2026-11-05 (src 56), so it applies again from 2026-11-10 unless extended; (4) new since the base: US data-center construction pauses large enough to cut 2027-28 AI-linked WFE (proposed read-through, judgment call). A close below $335 together with (2), (3) or a confirmed customer capex cut means the WFE downturn the downside case describes is under way; a close below it on sentiment alone does not. Original: $335 is ~18x FY27 consensus ($18.4 then, MarketScreener, which states no EPS basis; 18.3x the Zacks non-GAAP FY27 consensus of $18.28 on 2026-11-05, src 67) and ~15x a ~$22.8 NTM EPS, and ~19% below the $415.38 Sept-16 closing low that came on sentiment alone. A close there would mean a real 2027-28 WFE downturn is being priced: capex cuts at the October customer prints or in Micron's FY27 guide, an AMAT guide-down at the mid-November FQ4 report or in February, or the Affiliates Rule returning (Nov 10, 2026, the day after the stay ends per Federal Register 2025-19846, src 62, unless its suspension is extended with the truce to Jan 10, 2027). Agents' range is $330-340.
